Okami
Story

blocks.source: 主人公は犬の姿をした神様『アマテラス』。
blocks.translation: The protagonist is Amaterasu, a goddess in the form of a dog.

blocks.source: 日本の神話・民話を元に作られた和風ファンタジーなので、西洋風ファンタジーに飽きたという人には嬉しい存在。
blocks.translation: This is a Japanese-style fantasy based on Japanese myths and folktales, making it a welcome change for anyone tired of Western-style fantasy.

blocks.source: ラスボスの他、ボス戦前後の展開は王道で期待を裏切らない。
blocks.translation: Aside from the final boss, the developments surrounding the boss battles follow classic conventions and do not disappoint.

blocks.source: 初回プレイ時間は３０～６０時間程度で、寄り道しだいで大きく変わる。
blocks.translation: A first playthrough takes approximately 30–60 hours, depending greatly on how much time you spend exploring side areas.

blocks.source: 美術面・音楽面に非常に優れた作品なので、クリア特典には２週目の他にサウンドテストや設定画集などもあるのが嬉しい。
blocks.translation: This is an outstanding work in terms of both art and music, so it is nice that the completion bonuses include a second playthrough, a sound test, and a collection of concept art.
System

blocks.source: 基本的にはゼルダ系で、謎解きが中心となる。画面に線を描くと、効果が現れる筆しらべというシステムが大きな特徴。
blocks.translation: At its core, it is a Zelda-style game focused on solving puzzles. Its defining feature is the Celestial Brush system, which produces various effects when you draw lines on the screen.

blocks.source: 戦闘はアクション戦闘となっているが、色々と大味な出来栄えで、勝つか負けるかといった熱戦を楽しむようなものではない。特にボス戦は戦いというよりも、パズル的な要素が大きい。
blocks.translation: The battles are action-based, but they are somewhat simplistic and are not designed for thrilling contests where you wonder whether you will win or lose. Boss battles in particular have more of a puzzle element than a combat one.
Balance

blocks.source: 戦闘は非常に簡単。回復アイテムも多用できるので、まずゲームオーバーにはならない。
blocks.translation: The battles are extremely easy. You can also use recovery items liberally, so you are unlikely to get a game over.

blocks.source: 宝箱は多いけれど中身は消耗品・換金アイテム・はぐれ珠がほとんど。はぐれ珠は全部（１００個）集めると、最強のアクセサリを持って、２週目を開始できる。でも、僕は２週しないんで……。
blocks.translation: There are plenty of treasure chests, but most contain consumables, items that can be sold, or Stray Beads. Collecting all 100 Stray Beads lets you start a second playthrough with the strongest accessories. But I do not play through games twice...

blocks.source: 戦闘がぬるいのは物語を楽しむにはむしろよいと思う。ただ『宝箱の中身』『店の商品・価格』『アイテムの性能』といった基礎的な部分の調整もわりと大雑把なので、ＲＰＧ的な手応えは求めないほうがよさそう。
blocks.translation: I think the easy battles are actually good for enjoying the story. However, the basic elements, such as the contents of treasure chests, shop items and prices, and item performance, are also adjusted rather roughly, so it is probably best not to expect much of an RPG challenge.
Comfort

blocks.source: この作品、快適性だけは本当に期待しないほうがよいと思う。ＰＳ２の作品の中でもかなり酷いほうなので。
blocks.translation: I really do not think you should expect much in terms of comfort from this game. It is among the worst offenders on the PS2.

blocks.source: ロードは非常に長い上に回数が多い。ＰＳ２の有名作品で、ここまで酷いのはテイルズオブジアビスぐらいかも。イベント中にロードが入ることもしょっちゅう。 一応、ロード中にボタンをタイミングよく押したり、連打すると、アイテムが手に入るミニゲームがある。体感時間は多少マシだけど、やっぱり長い。
blocks.translation: Loading times are extremely long, and there are many of them. Among well-known PS2 games, Tales of the Abyss may be the only one this bad. Loading screens even appear frequently during events. There is, at least, a minigame in which you can obtain items by pressing buttons at the right time or mashing them during loading. The perceived waiting time is somewhat improved, but it is still long.

blocks.source: このゲームのウリの１つである筆しらべは斬新であるかわりに、テンポは今ひとつ。特に戦闘中に筆しらべを使う場合、戦闘の流れを止めてしまう。あんまりスピーディな戦闘とかは期待しないほうがよいかも。
blocks.translation: The Celestial Brush, one of this game's selling points, is innovative, but it does little for the pacing. Using it during battle in particular brings the flow of combat to a halt. You probably should not expect very fast-paced battles.

blocks.source: 経験値を入手するには戦闘ではなく、動物に餌をやったり花を咲かせたりする必要があるけれど、どれも時間がかかる。特に餌やりはロードが入るのがキツい。せっかちさんには辛いゲーム。
blocks.translation: To obtain experience points, you need to feed animals and make flowers bloom rather than fight battles, but all of these activities take time. Feeding animals is especially painful because it triggers a loading screen. This is a difficult game for impatient players.
Art

blocks.source: グラフィックは独特な水墨画風で世界観を表現。技術力の進化によって、このような作品も表現できるようになったというのは感動的。
blocks.translation: The graphics express the game's world through a distinctive ink-wash painting style. It is moving to see how advances in technology have made it possible to create works like this.

blocks.source: イベントシーンのカメラワークは迫力がある。塞の芽復活シーンは並みのゲームのエンディング並に美しい。
blocks.translation: The camera work in the event scenes is impressive. The scene where the bud of the Sakuya tree is revived is as beautiful as the ending of an ordinary game.
Music

blocks.source: 音楽は和風テイスト。といって、古臭いものではなく、うまく一般向けにアレンジされている。ラストバトルの曲はゲーム音楽史上屈指の人気曲の１つ。
blocks.translation: The music has a distinctly Japanese flavor. That said, it is not old-fashioned; it has been skillfully arranged for a general audience. The last battle theme is one of the most popular songs in the history of video game music.
